event_name: Date 01 November 2020 Time 14:52 2020 EMILIA ROMAGNA GRAND PRIX 30 October - 1 November 2020 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following

offence: Breach of Art 27.3 of the Formula One Sporting Regulations and the Race Directors notes (Ref. Art 12.1.1.i of the International Sporting Code.)
reason: The Stewards reviewed video and received timing information from the Race Director. The car left the track on multiple occasions without justifiable reason.
